Axiom:
The exploration loop is fixed at four steps and runs to completion before any test file is touched: 1. **Explore** — `page.goto(url)`; `page.ariaSnapshot()`; read structure. 2. **Interact** — `page.getByRole(...).click()` / `.fill()` / `.press()`; re-capture `ariaSnapshot()`; observe delta. 3. **Verify** — compare observed structure against expected intent; if mismatch, fix the component first, restart, re-explore. 4. **Capture** — record the final AX snapshot and any required screenshots as the basis for the committed test.
Skipping a step (e.g. interacting without re-snapshotting) hides the contract drift the loop exists to surface.
